**Plan** (`out/T3/plan.yaml`): delete the 48 non-parameter buffers → `cast_` everything remaining to float32 → `cast_` only the 64 projection weights (`attention.query_key_value/dense`, `mlp.dense_h_to_4h/dense_4h_to_h`) to bfloat16 → assert checks → sharded safetensors output at `256MB` (= 268,435,456 bytes).

**Asserts implemented:** total tensor count is 196, the projection regex matches exactly 64 tensors and is bfloat16, everything else (via negative lookahead) is float32 (this pins the bf16 count at exactly 64, not just "at least"), plus the two specific spot checks from the task (`query_key_value.weight` layer 0 is bfloat16, `embed_in.weight` is float32).

**Result:** single execution, all asserts passed, output has 196 tensors across 9 shards + index — the two 206MB embeddings (now 412MB each in fp32) landed alone in their own shards as required, all other shards ≤256MiB of tensor data. `REPORT.md` written with the self-report.
